text:
Maya P: Need a quick asset QA for HelioGrid before we push to the marketplace. They uploaded imagery + logo here: https://files.redwood.com/heliogrid/assets.zip. Main check: micro-tile, hero banner lockup, alt text, and quote attribution. Target publish Thu.
Jon (design): Downloaded. Two immediate items: 1) horizontal lockup over image needs extra left clearspace at <600px; 2) white reversed SVG looks fine but 1x PNG anti-aliasing needs a tiny trim. For micro-tile (140x140) use compact mark centered + 8px clearspace. Exports: SVG compact, PNG 140x140, 280x280, hero preview 900x360.
Luke H (HelioGrid): Confirming official byline: "Luke Hsu, Head of Cloud Partnerships". HelioGrid approves quote: "Reduced inference latency by 40% in production." Consent form uploaded: HG-AG-2026.
LegalBot: Consent received but need partner to confirm formal company name for headline. Also request that quote is verbatim as signed.
PartnerOps: Partner confirms formal name: "HelioGrid Technologies, Inc." and quote verbatim OK. Uploaded signed PDF to the same folder.
Maya P: Perfect. Jon, can you set CTA on dark hero to #003f9f to pass AA? Also add alt text suggestion: "HelioGrid compact mark 0 production-grade inference hardware and software" (we'll tidy copy).
Jon (design): I'll export with CTA #003f9f and re-export PNGs without halo. Adding alt text file to assets folder.
MarketplaceOps: Reminder of constraints: title <= 60 chars, short desc <= 140 chars, alt <= 125 chars. Paste final strings here and we'll validate length and encoding for FR/DE locales. Also we'll run automated contrast checks once assets are posted.
Maya P: Proposed strings:
- title: HelioGrid Technologies, Inc. 1 Redwood integration for low-latency inference (58 chars)
- short_desc: Joint solution delivering 40% lower inference latency with optimized batching and quantization (112 chars)
- alt_text: HelioGrid compact mark 0 on-prem and cloud inference infrastructure for LLMs (95 chars)
Jon (design): Minor cleanup: remove control chars in those strings; I'll reference exact alt text in the uploaded metadata file.
LegalBot: Confirmed quote and company naming are consistent with signed consent. No legal blockers.
PartnerOps: I've uploaded final exports and a metadata.json with alt text + credit line to the assets folder: https://files.redwood.com/heliogrid/exports_v1.
MarketplaceOps: Received. I'll validate lengths and run AA. Tentatively scheduling publish Thu 10:00 PT if checks pass.
Maya P: Thanks team 1 final checklist: 1) Jon confirm exports (done); 2) PartnerOps confirm metadata upload (done); 3) LegalBot sign-off (done); 4) MarketplaceOps schedule publish after AA. Ping here when live. :rocket:
